name: Colorblindly
summary: Lays a CSS color filter over the page to simulate eight color-vision deficiencies (protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia and their weak variants) for checking whether meaning survives without color.
browsersNote: The project's GitHub states it is Chrome-only; no Firefox or Edge listing found.
license: MIT (GitHub repo oftheheadland/Colorblindly, linked from the project).
goodFor: Checking that meaning survives for all eight common color-vision deficiencies.
install: Open the store page in your browser.
Choose Add to Chrome (or Add to browser) and confirm the permissions the store page lists.
Find the extension in the extensions menu (chrome://extensions in Chrome) and pin it if you want it in the toolbar.
keywords: colorblind color vision deficiency simulator protanopia deuteranopia tritanopia accessibility
